title: ICMPv6: Enhancements based on/required by RFC 9926
description:
This change updates the following:
- Interface-ID field of an ARO message is used as
  'Registration Ownership Verifier' (ROVR) field in
  EARO messages.  
  Implemented field based on T-flag.  
  (RFC 8505)
- Updated P-field values  
  (RFC 9926)
- Implemented C-flag  
  (RFC 8928)
- Implemented re-use of status field (Flag/Prefix length/Status)  
  (RFC 9926/9927)
- Implemented Extended Duplicate Address Message and
  ICMP Status Codes for Duplicate Address Messages  
  (RFC 8505)
- Fix a typo

(6CIO changes already done)  
Ping !23660

AI-Assisted: no
